newsitem.title: USA: Micron reduces corporate computer prices.
newsitem.headline: Micron reduces corporate computer prices.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc said Monday that it is cutting prices across its corporate desktop and workstation product lines.

The price reductions on Micron's Powerdigm workstations and ClientPro corporate desktops are attributed to Micron's business model, which allows the company to pass savings immediately along to its customers by taking advantage of component price reductions.
The company said the price cuts are also a result of Micron keeping very low inventory levels of leading-edge products on hand.
